mentions.name: xlsx.com
mentions.description: This is a web tool for auditing and cleaning up messy Excel workbooks, built as a quick helper to fix inherited, disorganized spreadsheets.
mentions.problem: Messy inherited Excel workbooks that needed auditing and cleaning up.
mentions.audience: Individuals dealing with messy personal Excel workbooks.
mentions.source_excerpt: http://xlsx.com - I stumbled into ownership of this domain a number of years back and life and other projects took precedence over doing something with it. My wife recently inherited a number of messy Excel workbooks and needed some help auditing and cleaning them up, so I created this as a quick tool to help her.
mentions.author: giltone
